title: 14-20 Lodge St & 195-209 Regina St North (Z-25-21)
body:
Holding Removal - 14-20 Lodge St & 195-209 Regina St N
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies before anything can be built.
Wilfrid Laurier University is requesting to lift the Holding provision at 14-20 Lodge Street and 195-209 Regina Street North.
The Zoning By-law Amendment will lift the Holding provision on 14-20 Lodge Street and 195-209 Regina Street North to permit development. There are no other changes to the Zoning By-law, or any proposed redevelopment or construction associated with this application.
View the documents submitted by the applicant under supporting documents on this page for more details.
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the delegated staff authority, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
